_doc: Single source of truth for the capability boundary of every Olympus Squad preset.
scripts/check_presets.mjs reads THIS file (and only this file) to derive its assertions;
it never hardcodes a second copy of the matrix. The values describe the TARGET contract
bash      : preset mounts the shell group / tool-bash plugin
fs        : tool-fs config values. boolean = must be EXPLICITLY present with that value;
null = not pinned here (inherits the DSH default, only presence of tool-fs
is asserted). We only pin `false` explicitly because a deny must be explicit,
while an inherit-on default is safe to leave implicit.
control   : preset mounts tool-subagent-control (expected exactly 1 row when true).
subagent  : preset mounts tool-subagent (the delegation tool). Only the lead owns this;
every member MUST be false (a member re-delegating is privilege escalation).
Members' `control: true` is now a HARD assertion in the default run: every member must
mount exactly 1 tool-subagent-control row. A missing/extra row fails check_presets with a
non-zero exit and names the offending preset (no KNOWN-GAP allowance, no warning-and-exit-0
path). `--strict` is accepted for CLI compatibility only and does not change behaviour.
